methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: add the sustainability dimension in order to integrate the corresponding formal management systems and establish the comprehensive Total Site Resource Efficiency System (TSRES)

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes the Total Site Resource Efficiency System (TSRES), a framework integrating sustainability dimensions and formal management systems (ISO 9000/14000/50001/26000, EMAS) at plant/community level. ISO 50001, energy efficiency, Pinch Analysis and MINLP appear only at framework level; the paper presents no EnPI/EnB measurement model and characterises no indicator definition, normalisation variables, functional form, or baseline construction.

paper_type.evidence_quote: integrated into a unique management system which is included into the novel Total Site Resource Efficiency System

stage1.notes: Borderline paper_type: primarily a framework/system proposal (TSRES) with a thin illustrative single case (industrial laundry in a coalmine), so 'single applied case' is a defensible alternative. ISO 50001 cited only as a management system to integrate, not as a basis for an energy-performance model.
